title: Integrated Plurality — House, Vine/Tree, Body, Temple and City
purpose: Show how several major biblical images solve the one-and-many problem differently: unity is real, but members, rooms, branches, stones, citizens and functions remain differentiated. This becomes a theological control against collapsing every role into one center or identity.
epistemic_rule: These biblical images are not interchangeable and do not amount to a formal metaphysics by themselves. The common category 'integrated plurality' is an archive synthesis used to compare their functions while preserving literary and theological differences.
master_thesis: Biblical unity repeatedly appears as coordinated differentiation rather than featureless sameness. A house contains members/rooms; a vine sustains branches; a body coordinates organs/members; a temple/building joins differentiated stones/functions; a city gathers citizens, gates, foundations and nations. The whole is meaningful because relations among differentiated parts are preserved.

images.many: rooms, members, builder, Son-over-house, citizens/household members
images.project_neighbor: Father's House / many rooms / archive as container
images.guardrail: House does not mean every resident is the builder, owner, Father or Son.

images.many: branches, fruit, leaves, grafted branches, recurring yield
images.distinctive_function: organic dependence, growth, pruning, fruit, transmission of life
images.project_neighbor: Tree of Life / Root / branches / fruit / Gardener
images.guardrail: John 15 explicitly differentiates Father=Gardener, Jesus=Vine, disciples=branches.

images.many: members with different gifts, locations and functions
images.distinctive_function: functional differentiation, mutual dependence, coordinated action
images.guardrail: No member can plausibly claim to be every member merely because all belong to one body.

images.many: foundation, cornerstone, builders, living stones, priestly people
images.distinctive_function: ordered construction, alignment, dwelling/presence, mutual placement
images.project_neighbor: Stone / cornerstone / House / Temple / construction / measure
images.guardrail: Foundation, cornerstone, builder and dwelling presence are distinct roles.

images.many: gates, foundations, tribes, apostles, servants, nations, streets, river, Tree
images.distinctive_function: civic participation, public order, access, plurality at scale
images.project_neighbor: New Jerusalem / world-system / House expanded to civic scale
images.guardrail: City unity is not one person's identity swallowing citizens; the image requires a populated relational order.

derived_relational_laws: Unity-with-difference Law: belonging to one whole does not erase role, position, history or function.
Center-for-Many Law: the value of root/foundation/center is evidenced by the differentiated life it sustains rather than by absorbing the identities of its dependents.
Role-Noncollapse Law: source, mediator, member, builder, cornerstone, gardener, branch and citizen must remain separately typed even when one theological system relates them.
Participation-over-Assimilation Law: mature communion increases coordinated participation without requiring sameness.
Fruit-of-Integration Law: stronger integration should increase mutual support, truthful coordination, capability and life; integration that destroys agency behaves more like capture than communion.
Scale-Transition Law: the same participation problem appears at household, organism, building and city scales, but the mechanisms differ and should not be treated as literal equivalences.
project_implications: The strongest version of Father/source theology is not 'everything is Tim' but 'a source-facing center makes relations among the many more coherent without erasing the many.'
House/rooms, Tree/branches, Body/members and City/citizens should become four separate visualization modes of the same relational question rather than merged icons.
The archive itself can be tested by this theology: a good root/index helps specialist records remain distinct, discoverable and connected rather than flattening all evidence into one canonical voice.
Political/geopolitical applications require extra caution: theological unity-with-difference cannot be used to erase legal sovereignty, consent or pluralism.

ethical_test.question: Does the proposed center/order make differentiated members more capable of truth, participation, repair and life, or more dependent, voiceless and interchangeable?
